product_metadata.title: Swan Creek Drizzle Melts Wax Warmer Triple Scented Cubes - 2 Pack Bundle (Roasted espresso)
features: FILL YOUR HOME with the warm and inviting fragrant aroma of freshly brewed coffee with these triple scented wax cubes
LONG LASTING FRAGRANCE - One cube of Drizzle & Herbal Melts will burn for 20 – 25 hours due to the all-natural 100% American soybean wax and they are lead free.
EASY TO USE with six separate break-apart cubes – just place them in your favorite wax melter and enjoy!
MAKE YOUR HOME SMELL AMAZING with the delightful scents from Swan Creek Candle Co – Mix and Match any of their tempting products in their collection made here in the USA

DRIZZLE MELTS MAKE A GREAT GIFT for a new neighbor, co-worker and of course, your family! They will be delighted with high quality wax and fresh scents. You’ll receive two (2) packages of six (6) cubes. Give one as a gift and keep the other for yourself!
description: Drizzle & Herbal Melts are made from 100% all-natural soybean wax. They are sure to delight your senses with their long lasting triple scented fragrances. Drizzle Melts are sold in break-apart packaging with six cubes per package. You will receive two packages of Roasted Espresso Drizzle Melts for a total of 12 cubes. Use these aromatic cubes in your favorite wax warmer to fill your home for hours with warm and inviting scents.
